state:
**Goal `ext-tooling` — `nvs ext` builds, inspects, tests and pins an extension, and a bundle carries one — Stage 2 is under way.** M9. No floor is carried: the suites, the `.nvst` trees and `nv verify` are the safety net, and goals `ext-host`, `ext-compiler` and `ext-grants`' tests stay green as tests of the tree.

The design is ADR 0246 § 10 and the user's, and the goal file's § *Standing decisions* answers every call a session meets. No record slot: a question the record leaves is settled under AGENTS.md's priority ordering and written in `crates/nvs-cli/src/ext.rs`'s module doc.

On disk: `nvs ext build [dir]` works — `crates/nvs-cli/src/ext.rs`'s module doc says what it reads, where it writes (`<kebab class tail>.nvsx` beside `nvsx.toml`) and what it prints (the path, then `sha256 = "<pin>"`). It checks with `crate::extensions::loader()`, the loader boot uses. The packer refuses a WASI preview 1 module naming `wasm32-wasip2` (`nvs_ext::pack`). Six `nvs_ext_build_*` tests in `crates/nvs-cli/tests/ext_command.rs`, beside a `project()` scratch-project helper and WAT guests the next tests can reuse. `new`, `inspect`, `test`, `verify` and `pin` still print "not available" — **each stage that builds one removes it from `an_unbuilt_subcommand_says_so_and_exits_non_zero`'s list**. Still not on disk: the templates, `wasm32-wasip2` in `rust-toolchain.toml`, any bundle embedding.

items.text: **`nvs ext new --lang rust|c <dir>`** — `ExtCommand::New` at `crates/nvs-cli/src/main.rs:1001`, dispatched at `crates/nvs-cli/src/ext.rs:50`. Both templates under `crates/nvs-cli/templates/ext/` (embedded with `include_str!`), each with an `nvsx.toml` in the shape `crates/nvs-cli/src/ext/nvsx_toml.rs:1`'s module doc gives, and the world WIT written from the binary's own copy: `WORLD_WIT`/`WASI_WIT` at `crates/nvs-ext/src/pack.rs:39` are private and are the copy to expose (under `wit/deps/`, which `build` does not read as the author's package). The Rust `Cargo.toml` carries its own `[workspace]` table; the C one has a README naming `wit-bindgen-cli` and wasi-sdk. A non-empty folder is refused. Add `wasm32-wasip2` to `rust-toolchain.toml`. Remove `new` from the unbuilt list. `rule:packaging/nvs-ext-is-the-authoring-tool`; tests `nvs_ext_new_writes_a_rust_project_with_the_binarys_own_world`, `nvs_ext_new_writes_a_c_project_with_the_binarys_own_world`, `nvs_ext_new_refuses_a_folder_that_is_not_empty`. Template comments follow AGENTS.md § *Text an end user reads*.

backlog: Stage 3 `inspect`, `verify`, `pin` — goal file § Stage 3; `verify` can reuse `crate::extensions::loader()` as `build` does.
Stage 4 `test` needs `&cli.config` passed into `ext::run`, and finds the built file at `build`'s output path — goal file § Stage 4.
